goal: Add the domain function for correcting a book's title or author, so a later task can put an Edit button on the page. No page change in this task.
inputs: src/books.ts holds the pure domain functions; new logic goes there with unit tests in tests/books.test.ts.
Follow addBook's rule for a missing title or author: throw an Error. Do not trim or otherwise change the text.

acceptance_criteria.statement: renameBook(books, id, title, author) returns a new array in which only the book with that id has the given title and author; every other field and every other book is unchanged, and the input array and its books are not modified.
renameBook throws an Error when the title or the author is empty, and when no book has that id.
